jobs.title: Software Engineer II - SDK
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

The SDK team within AGS is responsible for designing, developing, and implementing both front and back-end features for use by our internal game studios, as well as leading and supporting company-wide initiatives to introduce the most modern technologies and frameworks into both internal and customer-facing products. Developers within SDK work both inside and outside of our game system’s primary codebase to create comprehensive solutions to new requirements and challenges faced by our engineering teams in bringing games to market. Our team places a high value on distribution of knowledge and skills throughout all members, as well as the flexibility to work alone, in groups, or with engineers outside our own team in order to identify and implement creative solutions in gameplay, engine, and platform systems.

**Responsibilities:**

* Software Engineer IIs on the SDK team are responsible for development of both Platform and Game Presentation features.
* You will be an active contributor in all aspects and stages of development, from participating in prototyping, requirements gathering and design, to implementation, documentation, deployment and maintenance.
* You will regularly act as a liaison between SDK team and Game Studios to communicate what the game platform can do, assist in solving technical challenges, and identify solutions to allow game requirements to work within the platform.
* Your knowledge and skills will be called upon to diagnose and implement optimizations or author coding or memory management strategies to improve game performance.
* You may be recruited to research or prototype new features or experimental changes to help improve the platform as a whole.
* This position requires a strong work ethic, a desire for continued self-improvement, and the willingness to engage with new or unfamiliar technologies or frameworks in search of the best solutions.
* It requires a commitment to being a positive contributor in both a group dynamic as well as independently, and to efficiently regulate workload within the team’s set objectives.

**Skills & Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering or equivalent.
* 5+ years professional software development experience.
* 3+ years of Unity3D or equivalent game development experience.
* Contributor to one or more shipped or live products having participated in both design and development activities.
* Excellent knowledge of C# including language fundamentals, OOP design practices and common patterns.
* Knowledge of effective testing solutions and tools, as well as strategies for memory and time optimization and verification.
* Demonstrate the capability to communicate efficiently and effectively in both written and oral forms.
* Demonstrate the capacity for organized, clear problem-solving skills even when faced with new or unfamiliar information.
* Strong internal motivation to be a team player within a fast-paced, customer-oriented development environment.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Shipped project(s) using the Unity3D engine.
* Professional experience within the casino gaming or slot gaming sectors.
* Skills or knowledge of networking systems TCP/UDP communication or multiplayer systems at a professional level.
* Skills or knowledge of graphics pipelines, OpenGL, rendering processes or image processing at a professional level.
* Professional experience relating to testing frameworks or test automation.
* Experience developing and deploying within a cloud architecture or containerized system architecture.

**Note: All offers are contingent upon successful completion of a background check**

* ***Posted positions are not open to third party recruiters and unsolicited resume submissions will be considered free referrals.***

***AGS is an equal opportunity employer.***

jobs.title: Software Developer III
jobs.description:
At **Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU)**, our members are at the heart of everything we do. Since 1951, we’ve been committed to delivering financial services founded on integrity and a people-first philosophy.

**This position is a 6 month contract-to-hire.**

**As a Software Developer III**, you will be responsible for the designs, codes, and develops new financial applications or web based systems and/or modifies existing core financial application systems and web based systems.

**Why Join SCCU?**

* **Member-Focused Mission**: Be part of a not-for-profit organization that reinvests in its members.
* **Flexible Schedule Options**
* **Career Growth**: We prioritize internal promotions and offer on-the-job training.

**Software Developer III Key Responsibilities**

* Responds to end user trouble calls to resolve routine application software problems or assist with hardware issues remotely when possible. Routes calls as needs for more non-routine questions. Track tickets in an incident management system to properly identify problem and resolution for a shared knowledge base or escalate and assign as needed for higher level support.
* Designs, develops, tests, and integrates moderately complex internal and external core and web applications, services, and sites, including maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting in order to fulfill business needs. Assists in determining cost and schedule of various software projects using current and proven software engineering
* Provides tier III technical support for staff on internal and external core and web applications and systems.
* Confers with vendors, other IT team members, users, and department managers to determine requirements for new or modified software and hardware. Tests new hardware and software configurations for usability and proper function, including cross-browser functional capability. Develops web security safeguards and technologies. Consistently meets assigned project deadlines and goals.
* Reviews, analyzes, and modifies the application systems including encoding, testing, debugging, and documentation. Analyzes and resolves problems associated with application systems. Detects, diagnoses, and reports related problems.
* Uses AI to analyze requirements, identify questions and gaps, explore implementation approaches, generate or refactor code, explain existing code, and assist with troubleshooting.
* Creates effective prompts and context that clearly communicate the objective, application and business context, technical requirements, constraints, coding standards, acceptance criteria, existing patterns, examples, and expected output format.
* Uses iterative prompting and context refinement rather than relying on a single AI response.
* Uses AI, where appropriate, to create or improve unit tests, test scenarios, edge cases, negative tests, documentation, code-review summaries, implementation punch lists/checklists, deployment instructions, release notes, troubleshooting guidance, and knowledge articles.
* Uses AI to help identify security concerns, inappropriate dependencies, error-handling gaps, maintainability issues, missing tests, technical debt, and potential performance concerns.
* Validates AI-generated code and content before use. The developer remains responsible for ensuring generated output is correct, secure, maintainable, properly tested, and aligned with organizational standards.

**Software Developer III Requirements**

5 to 8 years prior experience with software analysis, design, development, testing, debugging, integration, deployment, support and documentation of core and web based systems following the software development lifecycle, or combination of applicable experience, education, and training which provides the knowledge and skills needed to perform job duties.

Front-end Developer skills: Front-end web development, React, JavaScript, CSS, JQuery, SASS, Bootstrap, and WCMS platforms. Familiarity with .Net, Visual Studio, Azure DevOps Server, C#, SQL Server and/or other relational databases, Node.JS, experience with client-server concepts, object-oriented programming, web services, and Waterfall/Agile development methodologies.

**Software Developer III Compensation**

$113,900.00 - $120,628.00

**SCCU Benefits**

* **Health & Wellness:** Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus an Employee Assistance Program.
* **Financial Perks:** 401(k) match (5%), HSA match, and SCCU-paid insurance (short/long-term disability, life insurance).
* **Education Support:** Tuition reimbursement after one year of service.
* **Generous Time Off:** 20+ days of PTO, birthday PTO, and 11 federal holidays.
* **Exclusive Discounts:** Lower rates on loans, credit cards, and no fee SCCU accounts!

**Work Schedule**

* Monday – Friday: 8:00 a.m. - 5:00 p.m.

**About SCCU**

Since 1951, **Space Coast Credit Union (SCCU)** has proudly served our community, growing to over 685,000 members and managing $9 billion in assets. With 67 branches spanning Florida’s east coast, we are the third-largest credit union in the state. In 2025, we expanded into Orange County to better serve the growing East Orlando market.

As a not-for-profit financial institution, SCCU is dedicated to putting our members first. Unlike traditional banks, we return profits to our members through better rates, lower fees, and enhanced services. While we offer the same financial products—like checking, savings, and loans—our focus remains on empowering our members and supporting their financial well-being. With local decision-making and a commitment to exceptional service, we strive to make a meaningful difference in the lives of those we serve.

At SCCU, we also prioritize our team members by fostering a supportive and collaborative environment that encourages career growth and development. As we continue to grow, we are seeking talented, member-focused professionals to join our team and help deliver innovative financial solutions and outstanding service.

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Full Stack Software Engineer**

Artly AI | Seattle, WA | Full-time | In person

Artly AI builds robots and the software that makes them useful in the real world. We are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer who can independently build, ship, and operate reliable software—and who has clear evidence of using AI development tools to deliver substantial production systems.

You will work across the stack on applications, services, data workflows, and tools that support our products and operations. We want to understand what you built, how it performed in production, which parts you personally owned, and how AI helped you deliver it. In your first 30 days, you will learn our architecture and operating workflow, reproduce local and deployment environments, and ship multiple small production improvements with tests and monitoring.

**What you will do**

* Own features and systems from requirements and architecture through implementation, release, monitoring, and iteration.
* Build web applications, APIs, backend services, data workflows, integrations, and internal tools.
* Develop software that helps our team and operators manage real-world robotic systems and operations.
* Use AI coding assistants and agentic development tools to accelerate implementation, debugging, testing, documentation, and refactoring.
* Review generated changes and validate correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
* Improve tests, CI/CD, observability, deployment and rollback procedures, reusable components, and documentation.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong professional software development experience, typically five or more years, or equivalent evidence of exceptional independent delivery.
* Meaningful ownership of software used in production, including responsibility after launch.
* Strong JavaScript/TypeScript skills and experience building frontend applications with React.
* Strong backend development skills in Java and Spring Boot, including APIs, databases, authentication/authorization, integrations, and failure handling.
* Practical experience with automated tests, code review, cloud deployment, monitoring, and production debugging.
* Demonstrated use of AI development tools on substantial real codebases. You can explain the workflow, show what improved, and describe how you found and corrected errors.
* Good technical judgment, clear communication, and the ability to make progress with incomplete requirements.

**Useful additional experience**

Robotics, IoT, telemetry, device management, 3D simulation, data pipelines, AI/ML tooling, distributed systems, infrastructure automation, or broad product ownership in a small team.

**Compensation and benefits**

* Annual base salary: $110,000–$170,000.
* Stock options.
* 20 paid vacation days per year.
* 10 paid holidays per year.
* Separate paid sick leave.
* Medical, dental and vision coverage.

**How to apply**

Submit your résumé and a short description of one substantial production system you shipped using AI development tools. Explain what it does, how it is used, the components and decisions you personally owned, how you used AI, how you verified the code, and one concrete outcome.

Links to a product, public repository, portfolio, or technical write-up are welcome. A sanitized description is sufficient for confidential work; please do not share proprietary code or sensitive employer information.

We value demonstrated contribution, engineering judgment, and reliable delivery. We do not evaluate AI proficiency by lines of generated code or by the percentage of code written by a tool.

This is a full-time, in-person position in Seattle, Washington. Learn more about Artly AI: https://artly.ai

Pay: $110,000.00 - $170,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid holidays
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Describe one substantial production system you personally shipped using AI development tools. What did you own, how was it used, what did AI contribute, how did you validate the code, and what evidence shows the outcome? A sanitized example is sufficient; do not share proprietary code or sensitive information.
* Describe an AI-generated defect or difficult production failure you personally diagnosed. How did you identify the cause, validate the fix, and prevent recurrence? Explain your own contribution and the tradeoffs you considered.

jobs.title: GNC Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Description:

You will develop the guidance and control software that carries a flight vehicle from ascent through atmospheric entry and an autonomous runway landing. Your algorithms and C++ code will be exercised in high-fidelity simulation, hardware-in-the-loop environments, and ultimately in flight. You will help maintain the six-degree-of-freedom simulation that the broader program depends on for design decisions and mission confidence. If you value simple, testable software and want your work connected directly to vehicle performance, this role offers meaningful end-to-end ownership.

**WORKSITE**: Onsite in Titusville, Florida

**WORK SCHEDULE:** Full-time; schedule based on program needs

**PAY RATE:** Salary determined based upon experience

**WHAT WE OFFER:**

Paid sick leave based on state regulations after 90 days of employment

Medical, dental, and vision coverage after a waiting period (60% paid by Fortuna)

Free TeleMedicine and Mental Health support for all employees and their families.

Additional voluntary benefits: Group Life Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Critical Care, Short-Term Disability

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

Develop, integrate, test, and maintain flight GNC algorithms in C++ for ascent, entry, terminal-area energy management, approach, and autonomous landing.

Build and maintain a high-fidelity six-degree-of-freedom vehicle simulation used for algorithm development, verification, and program decision-making.

Model vehicle dynamics, sensors, actuators, atmosphere, navigation inputs, and failure cases with appropriate fidelity for each phase of flight.

Design and execute software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop tests, analyze results, and resolve discrepancies between models, hardware, and expected performance.

Collaborate with flight software, avionics, aerodynamics, propulsion, systems, test, and operations teams to define interfaces and verify integrated behavior.

Support mission rehearsals, flight-readiness activities, console operations, and post-flight data review for test and flight events.

Requirements:

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

At least five years of experience in guidance, navigation and control, flight controls, vehicle dynamics, robotics controls, or flight-critical embedded software.

Strong C++ development skills and a solid foundation in control theory, numerical methods, rigid-body dynamics, and state-space modeling.

Experience developing or maintaining six-degree-of-freedom simulations and validating algorithms through software-in-the-loop or hardware-in-the-loop testing.

Experience with flight-critical software, autonomous vehicles, launch vehicles, reentry vehicles, missiles, aircraft, or spacecraft is strongly preferred.

Bachelor's degree in aerospace, mechanical, electrical, computer engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent directly relevant experience.

Ability to work onsite in Titusville, Florida, communicate technical results clearly, and develop straightforward, testable, maintainable code.

Fortuna is a certified veteran-owned IT consulting and staffing company, comprised of practicing professionals all of whom are committed to excellence in providing the most efficient and innovative information technology solutions customized to our clients' specifications.

Career Site: www.gofortuna.com.

jobs.description:
Latitude AI (lat.ai) is building the future of Ford's autonomy roadmap to make travel safer, less stressful, and more enjoyable for everyone. Bringing this vision to scale, our fully in-house developed hands-free ADAS platform will debut on the all-new Ford Fathom in 2027.

When you join the Latitude team, you'll work alongside leading experts across machine learning and robotics, cloud platforms, mapping, sensors and compute systems, test operations, systems and safety engineering – ***all dedicated to redefining the relationship between people and their vehicles for millions of customers.***

As a Ford Motor Company subsidiary, we operate independently to develop automated driving technology at the speed of a technology startup. Latitude is headquartered in Pittsburgh with engineering centers in Dearborn, Mich., and Palo Alto, Calif.

**Meet the team:**

The Virtual Test Ecosystem (VTE) team ensures that our simulation (fully synthetic) and resimulation (replay engine using vehicle logs) workflows run efficiently and reliably at large scale. We use a mix of open source and cloud provider services to implement a processing framework that's cloud-agnostic as well as capable of running on-prem. The results of these simulations is business-critical for us - they're used in order to allow autonomy developers and testers to do large-scale safety and performance testing of changes prior to in-vehicle testing. We interact with engineers throughout the onboard and offboard stack in order to ensure smooth end-to-end capabilities.

**What you'll do:**

* We run vehicle simulations at unprecedented scales in order to ensure we're releasing a safe product. You'll support this via improvements to our sim/resim cloud framework and applications that run on this framework. In terms of implementation, this involves a lot of Python coding, interacting with open source packages and various AWS/GCP services. In terms of analysis, we're constantly looking for bottlenecks that limit scalability or otherwise hinder performance. You'll put together benchmarking to identify these spots and associated dashboards to track and summarize the information. Then armed with that information, you'll implement solutions to increase efficiency.
* It's not enough to have a framework that is functional - it needs to be intuitive and easy to use. We take our best guesses at this, but things evolve over time based on user interaction - both direct feedback as well as realizing how users are accidentally misusing or misinterpreting the results. VTE supports autonomy, systems, test, and a variety of other teams across the organization. Having an eye for how the system is being used, what users need, and a willingness to engage with these users on future improvements is critical.
* We also can't build it all, so we want to make the framework well-documented and as self-serve as possible for others to extend it (while being there to answer questions). For example, when there's a new portion of the autonomy stack, we want that autonomy team to be able to update resim to add it in themselves so that they can iterate quickly.
* In order to run logs through resim, we need to first know what logs are interesting. You'll contribute to the ecosystem of how we manage storing and searching for these logs efficiently, including how we automate indexing the interesting actors and interactions in a scene and how we determine our dataset coverage.
* Once we've run resim, we want to do something with the updated logs. Frequently this involves metrics to analyze the AV's performance; these metrics could range from low-level performance of a particular detector in the stack to if the AV is meeting high-level business objectives. You'll both work on the sim/resim cloud framework implementation to make this easy for all developers to add in their metrics and support the metrics implementation themselves as needs arise.

**What you'll need to succeed:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field and 4+ years of relevant experience (or Master's degree and 2+ years of relevant experience, or PhD)
* Expertise in writing Python code that's efficient, well-documented, and well-tested
* 2+ years' experience writing scalable applications that execute in a cloud or HPC environment
* 2+ years' experience writing software that interacts with AWS and/or GCP services
* Familiarity with NumPy and scientific programming
* Willingness and desire to learn how onboard and offboard components interact with each other and propose solutions to improve how developers and testers work with both systems

**Nice to have (optional):**

* C++ development experience
* Experience with Kubernetes

**What we offer you:**

* Competitive compensation packages
* High-quality individual and family medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Health savings account with available employer match
* Employer-matched 401(k) retirement plan with immediate vesting
* Employer-paid group term life insurance and the option to elect voluntary life insurance
* Paid parental leave and Adoption/Surrogacy support program
* Paid medical leave
* Unlimited vacation and 15 paid holidays
* Daily lunches, snacks, and beverages available in all office locations
* Pre-tax spending accounts for healthcare and dependent care expenses

Pramaana was founded by a team out of Google, DeepMind, and Glean, combining frontier AI researchers and formal methods experts.

**The Role**
------------

We’re looking for a full-stack engineer with focus on infrastructure to build the tools and systems that help Pramaana’s engineers and researchers develop, test, deploy, and operate their work more effectively.

Your initial focus will be **DevOps and MLOps**: improving development environments and deployment workflows, making experiments and evaluations reproducible, and helping teams understand the behavior, performance, and cost of AI systems. You’ll build across interfaces, backend services, and infrastructure automation—not just maintain scripts or configure dashboards.

This is an early-stage role with scope across the company. As needs evolve, your work will extend into shared capabilities such as identity and access, LLM gateways, API-key management, training and inference platform maintenance, usage metering, and internal applications. You’ll work directly with the people using these systems, turning recurring friction into reliable, self-serve tools.

We’re looking for someone who treats internal tools as products: useful, understandable, well-maintained, and built around the workflows of the people who depend on them.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**

At Anduril's Tactical Recon and Strike (TRS) team, we're pushing the boundaries of aerial drone technology. We're the driving force behind groundbreaking products like Ghost, Anvil, Bolt, and Altius, taking them from concept to fully operational systems that are reshaping the landscape of defense and security. Our team tackles the entire spectrum of small drone development (Group 1-3), from the drones themselves to the critical equipment needed for testing, deployment, and operation. We thrive on solving complex challenges, collaborating with specialist teams to deliver cutting-edge solutions for our customers. In TRS, you'll be at the forefront of innovation, working with state-of-the-art technology and pushing the limits of what autonomous systems can achieve. If you're passionate about creating transformative technology and want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of defense capabilities, we want to hear from you. Join us in our quest to develop game-changing aerial systems that are redefining what's possible in tactical reconnaissance and strike operations.

This position is on the TRS Core Infrastructure team and will be focused on building the infrastructure to field TRS Products such as Altius, Ghost, Bolt and Anvil. Our charter is to provide the foundation for teams across Anduril to deploy cutting edge TRS autonomy and to tie it all together into an easy-to-use product. The solutions that you will create address the current needs of our customers and will have immediate impact towards the success of our products.

* Have an intuition for finding solutions to complex problems that involve multiple first and third party technologies (related to simulation, data management, compute infrastructure, networking, and more)
* Enjoy collaborating with team members and partners in the autonomy domain, and building technologies and processes which enable users to safely and rapidly develop and deploy autonomous systems at scale
* Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Sweet James Accident Attorneys is a rapidly growing, AI-powered personal injury firm based in Orange County, CA. In less than a decade, we've built a nationally recognized brand and a proprietary AI and automation stack that make us one of the largest and most efficient providers of legal services in the country. Our growth runs on a culture of excellence, compassion, and results: Our team is committed to exceptional client experience and to supporting one another in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. We invest in our people, encourage professional growth, and provide meaningful opportunities to build rewarding careers while making a real impact in our clients' lives.

**Lead AI Engineer**

**The details**

* Location: Sweet James Headquarters (Newport Beach, CA), on-site

* Team: Technology

* Reports to: Chief Technology Officer

* Compensation: $200,000 to $250,000 base salary, depending on experience

**The role**

Technology is how we practice law, not a department beside it. We have built a highly automated, AI-forward experience for every client-facing role, from intake to settlement, and it is one of the leading examples of applied AI in the legal field: Our case teams run at a fraction of the headcount our largest peers need for the same work. The systems behind that result are built in-house, and you will be one of the people building them.

Sweet James is seeking a Lead AI Engineer to own the direction, standards, and health of the AI platform and to lead the engineers who build it. This is a player-coach seat for a staff-level engineer ready to manage: You will set the architecture, turn the roadmap into a build plan the team can execute, and remain hands-on in the code.

You will report to the Chief Technology Officer and own how the platform is built and run. The distinction from our Senior AI Engineer seat is scope: Senior engineers own features end to end; you own the system they fit into and the people who build it.

**Responsibilities**

* Direction: Own the architecture of the AI platform (e.g., document intake and filing, fact extraction, case search, the internal assistant and its agents, voice agents) and review every major design before it is built. The roadmap is set by the Chief Technology Officer and product leadership; you decide how it gets built.

* Standards: Define how the team ships, including code review, testing, and the evaluation sets every AI feature must clear before release.

* Platform health: Own uptime, monitoring, incident response, and access controls across the platform, and ensure no system depends on one person.

* People and capacity: Allocate the team's capacity against the priorities the Chief Technology Officer sets, make the trade-offs when demand exceeds it, and coach, review, and hire the engineers who carry the work.

* Delivery: Ship production code yourself every week.

* Business partnership: Decide with attorneys, case managers, and operations leaders which work is worth automating next, and report results in hours returned, error rates, and adoption.

* Data governance: Set the rules for least-privilege access, audit trails, and which client and medical data may reach which model.

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Experience: 8+ years building production software, with a track record as the technical lead on systems other engineers depended on.

* Leadership: Mentoring, design review, and ownership of a team's output; formal people management is welcome but not required.

* LLM craft: Systems shipped to real users spanning prompt and tool design, retrieval, structured extraction, evaluation, and cost and latency tuning.

* Stack: Strong Python and TypeScript/Node, production SQL in Postgres, Docker, containerized cloud services (Azure preferred), CI/CD, and monitoring.

* Operations: Ownership of uptime, including on-call, incident reviews, and rollbacks.

* Communication: Clear design docs, runbooks, and plain-language explanations for non-engineers.

**Preferred:**

* Models and tooling: Anthropic Claude and OpenAI APIs at production scale; agent frameworks or the Model Context Protocol; vector search (e.g., pgvector); self-hosted or open-weight models (e.g., vLLM, Baseten).

* Workflow automation: Platforms such as n8n.

* Salesforce: The data model and APIs; Litify a plus.

* Voice: Voice AI and telephony (e.g., Retell, Twilio, Zoom).

* Industry: Legal, insurance, or healthcare.

Sweet James is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

We will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act and applicable local law.

Stay safe: We will never ask for payment or banking information during the hiring process.

Questions? Contact careers@sweetjames.com

jobs.title: AI Developer Experience Engineer
jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

More and more PlanetScale databases are created, connected and queried by AI agents. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and a growing list of other tools now sit between developers and their infrastructure.

You will own that experience end to end. You'll make sure PlanetScale shows up everywhere developers build with AI, that our MCP server and CLI work flawlessly in every agent, and that we can measure how well it all works. Then you'll show the world how to do it well through demos, docs, blog posts, videos, and conferences.

This is a hands-on role combining engineering, content creation, and a strong public voice. You'll work closely with the teams that build our MCP server, CLI, API and docs.

The landscape of how developers work with AI changes fast. You'll have the opportunity to move quickly, experiment, and take the lead on the future of AI use with databases and infrastructure.

**Make PlanetScale great with AI tools**
----------------------------------------

* Build and maintain the plugins for PlanetScale in every AI marketplace and directory: agent plugins, skill registries, MCP directories, IDE extension stores and AI app builders
* Own our integrations with AI coding tools, agent frameworks and platforms
* Stay current with AI tools as they launch and ensure our customers have a great experience from day one
* Test the PlanetScale MCP server and CLI across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and other clients, and catch regressions before users do
* Find friction in creating a database, connecting, running migrations and debugging queries from inside an agent, then fix it or drive the fix with the owning team
* Improve the context agents rely on: tool descriptions, skills, llms.txt, docs written for agents, and error messages agents can act on
* Attention to AEO (answer engine optimization): make sure agents find and recommend PlanetScale
* Build and maintain skills for working with Postgres, MySQL, Vitess, Neki, and PlanetScale

**Measure how well we're doing**
--------------------------------

* Build evals that run real agent tasks against PlanetScale databases
* Benchmark how agents perform with PlanetScale and work towards continuous improvement
* Track how often AI assistants and agents recommend PlanetScale for database questions, and whether what they say about us is accurate
* Instrument and report on agent usage: databases created by agents, time to first connection, MCP versus CLI usage, and where sessions fail

**Show people how to do it well**
---------------------------------

* Build demos and sample apps that show PlanetScale and AI tooling at their best
* Write docs, guides and blog posts on using databases effectively with AI, including safe access, branching and performance assessment
* Make videos and attend conferences to communicate with our audience how to build effectively with AI

**These attributes best describe you**
--------------------------------------

* Daily use of AI coding agents, with strong opinions about what makes a tool work well with them
* Experience building an MCP server, plugin, CLI or SDK that real developers use
* Software engineering background in languages like TypeScript and Go, and comfort with APIs, OAuth and the command line
* Experience with writing docs, blogs, and / or video content creation
* Good at communicating with a broad audience and customers alike on socials
* Experience working with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, SQLite), schema design, migrations, connection handling, and Postgres or MySQL in production
* Data fluency: designing evals, writing the queries behind a dashboard, and telling a real trend from noise
* Clear communication of technical ideas in writing, on video and on stage
* Independence and speed: spotting a gap, shipping a fix, and telling people about it
* Genuine curiosity about the AI tooling landscape and a habit of keeping up with it

**Bonus points**
----------------

* Contributions to the MCP spec, SDKs or popular open-source MCP servers
* Experience writing agent skills, plugins or rules files for Claude Code, Cursor or Codex
* Experience with LLM eval tools and building benchmarks for agents
* Experience with AEO or GEO, or with tracking how LLMs surface and recommend a product
* A blog, YouTube channel or GitHub that developers already follow
* Experience with Vitess, database sharding, or running databases at scale
  

### **Why PlanetScale**

We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Software Engineer, you'll be at the core of building the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

### **Total Compensation and Pay Transparency**

An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

**Job Summary**
===============

Lead applied research in one or more Orbis AI focus areas — agentic AI, knowledge representation, dynamic ontologies, autonomous analysis, and high-performance analytics — and carry the results into the product. You will frame the problem, survey what already exists, build prototypes that test a real hypothesis, and measure honestly enough to act on the answer. The role exists because our advantage comes from turning advanced research into dependable mission capability.

* **Travel**: Up to 20% for conferences, customer engagement, and team collaboration.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. **Orbis Locations**

jobs.description:
**Data Platform Lead**
----------------------

Horizon AI is building the operating system for how organizations run themselves. The first step is autonomous data centers. A fleet of AI agents senses the state of STN’s GPU infrastructure, reasons about what it finds, and increasingly acts on it. This is running in production against real fleet data, not a prototype. Agents already take action where the risk is bounded and the outcome is verifiable. Everything riskier arrives as a recommendation for a human, and the work is moving decisions from the second category into the first, one class at a time, on evidence rather than optimism.

Data centers are the proving ground, not the destination. We start here because infrastructure is measurable and unforgiving: an agent is either right, or the fleet tells you it was wrong. What we build here generalizes, and we know where it goes next.

**Level:** Principal (MTS 5) · **Reports to:** Chief AI Officer

**The role.** Build the data foundation the platform reasons over. Today our agents assemble a picture of the fleet by querying several separate systems, and we cannot prove wider autonomy because we do not systematically capture how humans decide. You fix both.

**The problems you inherit**

* Fleet state is scattered across a relational store, a DCIM system, and multiple time-series and monitoring systems. Each has its own query path. There is no unified model. - No decision-capture pipeline exists. We record what agents did, but not what operators saw, concluded, and chose. That record is the evidence base for granting agents wider autonomy.
* Our retrieval pipeline is document-oriented rather than fleet-state-oriented.
* We consume telemetry from systems other teams operate, where retention and granularity are tuned for dashboards rather than for learning from history.

**You will**

* Design and build the fleet knowledge model: assets, topology, configuration, and current state, queryable by an agent in one call rather than five
* Build the decision-capture pipeline, and instrument the operator workflow so we accumulate labelled human decisions from day one
* Own the data access layer that abstracts telemetry sources, so we can keep consuming today and build our own collection if that stops scaling
* Negotiate our requirements with the teams who own the telemetry: signals, granularity, retention, raw event access
* Own the scale path, including vector index behaviour and the analytics separation a growing schema will eventually need

**You have**

* Strong data modelling judgment, particularly modelling physical or infrastructure domains as something queryable
* Experience with time-series and event data at scale, including cardinality and retention trade-offs
* Depth in PostgreSQL, including vector search, and comfort with a large evolving schema - Enough infrastructure literacy to know what a fleet actually is: nodes, GPUs, fabric, schedulers, power. Familiarity with DCIM tooling is a strong plus
* A bias toward shipping a usable model early over designing a complete one

**Nice to have:** GPU fleet or HPC exposure, DCGM, Slurm, entity resolution across inconsistent sources

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

Orbis is a technology company that delivers sovereign intelligence and decision capabilities to the United States Government and its allies. We convert complex information and operational systems into decisive outcomes, giving public institutions and critical enterprises the tools to move faster, see clearer, and act first in an increasingly contested world.

We are not a consulting firm and not a systems integrator. Every Orbis team is built around practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, and every engagement is judged on one thing: whether it produces working capability, not slide decks. Solutions forged from experience; that is how we build, and it is how we hire.

**Job Summary**
===============

Lead applied research in one or more Orbis AI focus areas — agentic AI, knowledge representation, dynamic ontologies, autonomous analysis, and high-performance analytics — and carry the results into the product. You will frame the problem, survey what already exists, build prototypes that test a real hypothesis, and measure honestly enough to act on the answer. The role exists because our advantage comes from turning advanced research into dependable mission capability.

**Travel**: Up to 20% for conferences, customer engagement, and team collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Frame research problems drawn from real product and mission gaps, define what a result must show to be worth productizing, and survey existing work before building.
* Build prototypes that isolate the question being asked, at the fidelity the question actually requires.
* Run rigorous experiments — baselines, ablations, held-out evaluation, and honest error analysis — with methodology another engineer can reproduce.
* Build and maintain the datasets and evaluation harnesses your area depends on, including cases that capture known failure modes.
* Report results clearly, negative results included, and make a defensible recommendation to continue, pivot, or stop.
* Transition validated results into production alongside product engineers, staying involved through the handoff rather than delivering a notebook.
* Contribute to the scientific community through publications, open-source releases, and academic collaborations, and advise Orbis on what in the field is worth adopting.
* Travel up to 20% for conferences, customer engagement, and team collaboration.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 3+ years of applied research or research-engineering experience, or an M.S./Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field with equivalent applied work
* Strong Python engineering skills, producing research code another engineer can read, run, and build on
* Demonstrated experience designing and running experiments that produced an actionable conclusion, with methodology you can defend
* Depth in at least one Orbis AI focus area: agentic AI, knowledge representation, dynamic ontologies, autonomous analysis, or high-performance analytics
* Working knowledge of modern LLM and retrieval methods and their practical limitations
* Clear technical writing that makes a result legible to engineers and non-specialist stakeholders alike
* Willingness to travel up to 20%

**Desired Qualifications**
==========================

* Publication record, open-source contributions, or academic collaborations in a relevant area
* Experience carrying a research result all the way into a production system
* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontology engineering, reasoning systems, or information extraction
* Experience with agent architectures, planning, or multi-agent coordination
* Experience with model training, fine-tuning, or evaluation at scale
* Experience with performance engineering on data-intensive or analytical workloads
* Familiarity with OSINT, intelligence, or investigative research workflows

**Physical Requirements**
=========================

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
* Participation in virtual and in-person meetings
* Ability to attend planned meetings and/or work in classified spaces for extended periods within the specified work regions
* **Travel**: Up to 20% for conferences, customer engagement, and team collaboration.

**Orbis Benefits**

Beyond the opportunity to work alongside practitioners who have operated at the mission edge, joining Orbis means real ownership over outcomes that matter; the chance to build technology that gives the United States Government and its allies a genuine decision advantage, not just another dashboard. From competitive retirement matching to a PTO policy that encourages real time off, we're committed to creating an environment where our team can do their best work and still have a life outside of it.

Our comprehensive benefits package is designed to meet the diverse needs of our employees and their families. A full list of benefits is shared with candidates following an initial conversation with our HR team, so you'll have a clear picture of the support and resources available to you as part of the Orbis team.

**Orbis Locations**

Orbis works in whatever arrangement the mission requires. Depending on the role, that might mean five days a week on a customer site, full-time in one of our offices, a hybrid schedule, or fully remote work; our team is spread across 25 states and four countries to match. We make sure every team member has the tools and access needed to do the work, wherever that work happens.

Travel is common across many Orbis roles, particularly those supporting customer missions in the field.

Orbis is headquartered in McLean, VA, with additional office locations in Taipei, Taiwan, and Canberra, Australia.

  

*Orbis is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment, and we make employment decisions based on merit,*

jobs.description:
Description

**Location:** Indianapolis, IN Metro (Hybrid / 3-Day Onsite) *(Open to Regional/EST Candidates with Onsite Travel)*

**Contract Type:** Contractor Full-Time / Enterprise Project Engagement (Outsourced via Xenon7)

About Xenon7

*Where elite tech talent meets world-class opportunities! At Xenon7, we work with leading enterprise clients and innovative startups on high-impact projects across Data, AI, Cloud, and Software Engineering. Our expertise in AI solution architecture and specialized technical talent allows us to partner with enterprise leaders on transformative initiatives, driving innovation and business growth.*

Role purpose

Lead the development and application of digital twins to improve clinical trial design and support evidence-based clinical development decisions. The role prioritizes digital-twin, simulation, and AI/ML expertise, supported by clinical-development experience and close partnership with trial-design experts.

Position overview

You will join a multidisciplinary clinical development environment and partner with clinical scientists, physicians, biostatisticians, pharmacometricians, biomarker experts, data scientists, data engineers, and other stakeholders. You will translate clinical development questions into quantitative strategies and deliver interpretable analyses that inform protocol design, patient selection, endpoint strategy, dosing, operational planning, and decision-making under uncertainty.

The role prioritizes digital twins as the primary capability for simulating patients, disease trajectories, treatment response, and clinical trials. The successful candidate will bring strong digital-twin, simulation, and AI/ML expertise, along with sufficient clinical-development knowledge to work effectively with trial teams. Deeper trial-design expertise can be developed through close collaboration with clinical scientists, biostatisticians, and pharmacometricians.

Key responsibilitiesDigital-twin development and validation

* Lead the design, development, and evaluation of digital twins of patients, disease trajectories, treatment response, or clinical trials using clinical trial and relevant external data.
* Combine mechanistic, statistical, causal, and machine learning approaches to create fit-for-purpose digital twins that can be simulated under alternative populations, interventions, dosing strategies, endpoints, or trial designs.
* Define use cases and contexts of use with clinical and quantitative experts so each digital twin addresses a specific trial-design or development decision.
* Assess calibration, validation, robustness, transportability, uncertainty, and practical relevance using appropriate internal and external evaluation strategies.
* Develop reproducible workflows and reusable digital-twin components that can be applied across programs or therapeutic areas.

Clinical trial design and quantitative decision support

* Partner with trial teams to frame development questions and evaluate design options, including target populations, eligibility criteria, enrichment strategies, comparators, endpoints, visit schedules, dosing strategies, and operational tradeoffs.
* Use digital twins and complementary simulation methods to compare plausible scenarios, characterize uncertainty, and support model-informed decision-making.
* Work closely with statisticians and pharmacometricians so analyses complement established trial-design methods and align with clinical and regulatory objectives.
* Communicate assumptions, limitations, and decision-relevant insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Data integration and scientific collaboration

* Analyze and integrate clinical trial data and, where relevant, biomarkers, imaging, digital health data, omics, patient-reported outcomes, and real-world data.
* Partner with data engineering and platform teams to create analysis-ready datasets, data-quality checks, lineage, and reproducible pipelines.
* Contribute to scientific documentation, presentations, publications, and responsible adoption of digital-twin methods across clinical development.

Model quality and responsible use

* Define the intended use, decision context, success criteria, and limitations of each model before development.
* Ensure models are interpretable, auditable, reproducible, and supported by evidence appropriate to their intended use.
* Apply appropriate governance, privacy, security, and scientific-review requirements for clinical data and analytical outputs.
* Clearly distinguish exploratory analyses from validated decision-support evidence and avoid overclaiming model capability.

 **Requirements**

* PhD in data science, statistics, biostatistics, pharmacometrics, computer science, biomedical informatics, engineering, mathematics, operations research, or a related quantitative field.
* Demonstrated experience developing digital twins, virtual patients, disease-progression models, clinical trial simulations, synthetic controls, or closely related computational models.
* Strong experience applying machine learning, statistical modeling, causal inference, or simulation to biomedical, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other complex scientific data.
* Strong programming skills in Python, R, or a comparable analytical language, with experience using version-controlled and reproducible workflows.
* Sufficient clinical-development knowledge to frame relevant questions and collaborate effectively with clinical and quantitative trial experts.
* Ability and interest to deepen clinical trial-design knowledge through partnership with clinical scientists, biostatisticians, and pharmacometricians.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and demonstrated effectiveness in cross-functional scientific collaboration.

Preferred qualifications

* Strongly preferred: experience supporting clinical trial design, protocol development, clinical development strategy, model-informed drug development, or regulatory-facing qua

jobs.title: Hardware Infrastructure Engineer II
jobs.description:
CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier—physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it's at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.

As CLEAR continues to expand its identity platform across physical and digital environments, our network of kiosks and connected devices forms the backbone of our member experience. Ensuring these systems stay secure, reliable, and always available is mission-critical, and that's where you come in.

We're looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Hardware Operations and Platform Engineering team. You'll be sitting at the intersection of Site Reliability Engineer and Embedded Systems Integration. You'll be architecting and maintaining the software layer that keeps thousands of Linux-based kiosks online, healthy, and self-healing, effectively operating a distributed server fleet at the edge.

You'll own everything from OS image management to over-the-air (OTA) updates, device observability, and system recovery, while ensuring our biometric kiosks deliver a consistent, frictionless experience to every traveler, every time.

### ***What You Will Do***

* Architect and implement OS-level watchdogs, process monitors, and self-healing mechanisms to ensure devices automatically recover from failures (service restarts, reboots, or rollbacks).
* Manage and enhance our OTA update framework to enable safe, atomic updates via A/B partition swapping and automated rollback when needed.
* Develop and maintain Python-based services that interact with connected peripherals (payment terminals, scanners, sensors) via vendor SDKs and serial interfaces.
* Own and maintain our custom Linux image (via Yocto, Buildroot, bootc, rpm-ostree, etc), managing systemd units, udev rules, and security policies for a locked-down, production-grade environment.
* Build lightweight monitoring agents to stream logs, metrics, and telemetry (connectivity, performance, temperature) to centralized observability systems such as Datadog or Splunk.
* Work closely with software, SRE, and field operations teams to identify pain points and develop scalable solutions that improve reliability and ease of maintenance.

### ***Who You Are***

* 3+ years of hands-on experience administering embedded Linux systems
* Strong proficiency in Python for system automation, service orchestration, and hardware communication.
* Familiarity with A/B update mechanisms (RAUC, Mender, SWUpdate, or custom partition-switching logic).
* Experienced in serial communications (UART, RS-232, USB-serial) and SDK-based hardware integration.
* Deep knowledge of service dependencies, timers, and watchdog configuration.
* Familiarity with network observability and remote device management at fleet scale.
* Committed to operational excellence, focused on designing for resilience, testability, and safe rollback.
* Collaborative, pragmatic, and curious; equally comfortable debugging a kiosk in the field or improving CI/CD for edge devices.

### ***Why You'll Love This Role***

* Massive impact: Your work ensures millions of travelers experience CLEAR's identity platform without disruption.
* Unique technical challenge: Operate and scale a distributed edge infrastructure at the intersection of IoT and reliability engineering.
* End-to-end ownership**:** From OS image to telemetry pipeline, you'll own the full stack of machine reliability.
* Collaborative culture: Deep cross-functional partnership with engineering and operations experts to create frictionless identity experiences.
* Continuous learning: Work on modern Linux, OTA updates, and observability systems at enterprise scale.

### ***How You'll be Rewarded:***

At CLEAR, we help YOU move forward - because when you're at your best, we're at our best. You'll work with talented team members motivated by our mission of making experiences safer and easier. jobs.description:
Overview:

**We are designing the grid of the future!**

Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. Together we can transform the future of energy.

Responsibilities:

**Join us in leading the** **change!**

We are seeking an experienced **Power Systems Software Engineer** to join the EPE software team. You'll sit at the intersection of transmission planning and software: turning the way planners actually run studies into reliable, automated, cloud-based tools that utilities, ISOs/RTOs, and developers use every day.

Your primary responsibility is to design, test, and validate software that supports and accelerates transmission planning and interconnection assessment workflows. You will work closely with power system engineers, software developers, and product owners to define requirements, automate processes, and make sure our tools produce results that engineers trust.

**How you can make an impact****:**

* **Domain requirements & product input:** Translate transmission planning practice (study scopes, criteria, contingency definitions, mitigation logic) into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for the development team.
* **Software design & testing:** Design and test features that enhance utility-scale generation interconnection and transmission planning assessments, including steady-state, short circuit, and dynamic stability workflows.
* **Automation & programming:** Use Python and related tools to automate study setup, execution, and post-processing, and to build tools that streamline transmission system studies and simulations.
* **Model & data management:** Work with power flow and dynamics case data, contingency and monitored-element files, and supporting data to keep models and inputs clean, versioned, and reproducible.
* **Software validation & benchmarking:** Benchmark tool results against established industry software and hand-calculated or reference studies; troubleshoot discrepancies to ensure accuracy, reliability, and performance.
* **Collaboration:** Partner with transmission planners, software developers, and cross-functional teams to develop and integrate solutions that energy development and planning teams need.
* **Documentation:** Write clear methodology notes, user guides, and release validation reports that help engineers understand and trust tool outputs.

**Bring your passion, here's what’s needed:**

* + Working proficiency in at least one major power system analysis tool (e.g., PSS/E, PSLF, PowerWorld, TSAT/DSATools, PSCAD, ASPEN, TARA).
* + Solid understanding of the US transmission network and generation development, including ISO/RTO market structures, interconnection queue processes, and NERC TPL planning standards.
* + Working knowledge of Python for scripting and automation of engineering workflows.
* + Strong presentation and communication skills: able to explain complex technical topics to engineers, clients, and non-technical audiences.

* + Excellent problem-solving skills, especially in identifying and resolving issues in power system simulations, models, and software results.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* + Strong programming and automation skills in Python, including power system APIs (e.g., psspy) and data libraries (pandas, NumPy).
* + Experience with software testing frameworks and practices (e.g., pytest, regression/benchmark test suites) and version control (Git).
* + Experience with Agile development, issue tracking (e.g., Jira), and writing requirements or user stories.
* + Familiarity with cloud-based software development, distributed or batch computing.
* + Experience with SPP, MISO, PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, or other ISO/RTO interconnection or transmission planning processes (e.g., DISIS, cluster studies, TPL assessments).
* + Familiarity with FERC Order 2023 and current interconnection reform.
* + Knowledge of AI-driven or machine-learning applications in power systems.
* Professional Engineer (PE) license or EIT.

Be a part of an innovative team shaping the grid of the future through advanced energy intelligence. For more than half a century, Electric Power Engineers (EPE) has partnered with power and energy clients across the globe, providing consulting expertise and energy intelligence software solutions for complex engineering and grid modeling challenges. As leaders in the renewables space, we are focused on building a modern, secure, and resilient grid. Join us in making an impact on the communities we serve and the environment in which we live. * Tune data models and queries to improve report performance and refresh reliability.

* Create and maintain clear documentation of data sources, pipelines, models, dictionaries, and business logic.

* Demonstrated ability to design relational and dimensional data models, including fact and dimension tables, keys, relationships, referential integrity, and historical changes.

* Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL, Synapse Analytics, Databricks, or Azure DevOps.

We are looking for a passionate, experienced Data Engineer to join Casper’s Data Engineering team as we continue building our data warehouse, data lake and platform capabilities. Our vision is supported by leveraging data and insights to drive the business forward. Data Engineering provides the platform that enables Casper to efficiently produce, manage and consume high quality data.

As an engineer, you will support the evolution of our data platform and analytics capabilities by driving how we process and model new data sets, develop/iterate on internal tooling and infrastructure, and support secure, scalable, and responsible data practices.

Casper (Casper.com) believes everyone should sleep better. That’s why we obsess over designing sleep products that actually make a difference—from the littlest dreamers and beyond. Including mattresses, pillows, and bedding, our entire collection is dreamed up and engineered in-house by our product and design teams. Sleepers can shop online, visit one of our 40+ retail locations across the United States, or find us through a growing network of trusted retail partners.

This is a hybrid role, requiring that you work 4 days per week from our Richmond, VA office.

**When you’re not catching zzz’s, this is what you’ll do...**

* Own the storage architecture in Amazon Redshift, including distribution and sort key design, RA3/managed storage tuning, and tiering cold data to S3/Spectrum to keep the warehouse fast and cost-efficient as data volume grows
* Design and maintain dbt models for high-volume event data at multi-billion row scale while balancing cost and efficiency.
* Build resilient ingestion pipelines from third-party platforms with idempotent loads so bad or partial loads never silently reach production tables.
* Diagnose and resolve pipeline performance bottlenecks and fine tuning workloads between raw to BI layer to prevent data outages.
* Set up monitoring and alerting across the pipeline to catch data anomalies before they compound.
* Work closely with data analysts to align warehouse design with stakeholder needs and LookML modeling, ensuring a robust, scalable foundation from raw tables through to the semantic layer
* Collaborate with other engineers and product managers in solving interesting and challenging problems across our systems
* Advance modern, agile software development practices and help build a culture of great engineering and organizational practices
* Learn from the team and on your own what you might not know about data infrastructure, business operations, and open source tooling to make you a stronger asset to the team
* Preference for familiarity with Redshift, S3, dbt, Airflow, Looker, Trino, Fivetran

**Our dream candidate is/has:**

* The following technical capabilities developed through at least 3 years of relevant work experience:
* + Expert in Python and SQL
  + Experience with Airflow, containerization and orchestration
  + Experience with a cloud data warehouse like Redshift or Snowflake
  + Knowledge of modern BI tools and dbt.
  + Salesforce, GA4, Shopify experience a plus
* A proven engineering background with experience developing data workflows and a good operational understanding of data operations, including processing, storage, quality and management
* Experience working with a diverse set of stakeholders and helping them understand the trade-offs to different product and technical decisions
* Appreciation for the business context that drives the need for data solutions and love working on projects to support those efforts
* Experience delivering timely, high quality data products and models

Targeted Annual Base Salary Range: $115,000-130,000 USD

Casper’s compensation philosophy ensures that the actual base salary is based on factors including but not limited to skills, education, experience, special training, time in position, and/or years of service.

We recognize that annual base salary is just one part of a total rewards package. In addition, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, wellbeing resources, and other perks including:

* Medical, vision, and dental insurance to help you with those coughs or cavities (too many waffles)...
* Paid Time Off. We believe in the power of rest so take the time you need to recharge.
* Employee Discount to use on whatever you like (with a few exceptions) and product discounts for friends and family!
* Dreaming of your next degree? After one year of service, we’ll help make that dream a little easier with tuition reimbursement.
* … and more!

If you dream about this stuff this job is probably right for you. We look forward to learning more about you!

*Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employer-sponsored visa support.*

*As part of our hiring process, employment offers are contingent on the successful completion of a background check and drug screening, where permitted by law.*

#### **Experience**

Required

* 3 year(s): Cloud Data Warehouse like Redshift or Snowflake
* 3 year(s): Airflow
* 3 year(s): Python and SQL

jobs.description:
Stratolaunch is a technology accelerator that engineers operationally realistic testing at Mach 5+. Our air-launched, Talon testbeds are reusable, cost-effective platforms that enable routine access to the hypersonic environment. We deliver flight data critical to validating system performance and achieving rapid technology deployment. Together with our customers, we drive innovations that are imperative to advancing national security.

Stratolaunch is seeking a Level I, II, or Sr-level Avionics or Flight Test Instrumentation Engineer to support the design, build, integration, and testing of experimental customer payloads on the Talon-A hypersonic vehicles. This position involves working with a multi-disciplinary engineering team, program management, and customers. An ideal candidate exudes passion and an interest in aviation.

* Evaluate experimental payload requirements to determine fit for integration onto a hypersonic test bed.
* Work across many teams and subsystems to define and implement collection and recording of experimental payload data

* Contribute to instrumentation and telemetry (data) system requirements development, design, testing, & operation for customer payloads
* Develop and support instrumentation and telemetry tests

* Make suggestions and recommendations for improvements, including changes to workflow

* Ability to acquire and maintain a DOW security clearance

  

**Required Skills**

jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
**nou Systems, Inc. (nSI) is a 100% employee-owned company!** We value teamwork and collaboration, and this transition allows us to take that commitment to a new level. nSI empowers our customers by supplying products, services, and expertise with powerful, data driven insights that transform defense systems and improve capabilities.

We are pleased to announce the opening for a Data Platforms Integrator (Engineer 4 / Analyst 4), who will support the Missile Defense Agency's (MDA) Next Generation Environment (NGE) program and become part of our technology company operating in missile defense, cybersecurity, test range modernization, biotechnology, and space control marketspaces. You will be part of a team known for delivering innovative technical solutions that support critical national security missions.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor in a Systems Engineering and Technical Assistance (SETA) capacity, directly supporting the Government Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and NGE leadership. You will provide technical oversight and integration guidance for the NGE Data Design Area, supporting the development of a secure, resilient hybrid multi-cloud environment.

You will evaluate existing applications, databases, and modern data platforms across AWS, Azure, and on-premises environments to ensure alignment with the Department of Defense (DoD) Zero Trust Strategy. Your work will focus on data discovery, classification, protection, and access governance to ensure mission-critical information remains secure and accessible only to authorized users.

**Responsibilities:**

You'll be responsible for:

* Serving as a senior technical authority in Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), evaluating proposed database architectures, data storage solutions, and data pipelines against NGE requirements and DoD Zero Trust mandates.
* Conducting technical assessments of existing mission applications, relational databases, NoSQL environments, and object storage repositories to identify modernization opportunities and Zero Trust integration gaps.
* Providing architectural oversight for enterprise data discovery, automated cataloging, classification, labeling, and tagging across hybrid multi-cloud environments.
* Designing and validating data protection solutions, including data-at-rest encryption, automated Data Loss Prevention (DLP), data rights management, and dynamic data masking.
* Ensuring data platform architectures align with DISA Thunderdome Zero Trust capabilities, including Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Cloud Access Security Broker (CASB), and enterprise DLP policies.
* Developing and evaluating fine-grained Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) solutions using Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) attributes and contextual risk assessments.
* Overseeing integration of Policy Enforcement Points (PEPs) and Policy Decision Points (PDPs) to support dynamic authorization and secure data access.
* Providing technical guidance for data virtualization, database security, and access governance across AWS, Azure, and on-premises VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) environments.
* Ensuring compliance with DoD Data-at-Rest (DAR) requirements, Key Management Service (KMS) integration standards, Hardware Security Module (HSM) requirements, and applicable JSIG and NIST SP 800-207 guidelines.
* Evaluating data platform modernization strategies and integration approaches to improve interoperability, security, and enterprise data governance.
* Leading technical exchange meetings (TEMs) with integration contractors, database vendors, and security technology providers to evaluate proposed solutions and resolve cross-platform integration challenges.
* Translating Government leadership requirements into actionable engineering solutions while maintaining alignment with NGE architecture and DoD cybersecurity standards.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* You must have a Master's degree in a STEM discipline with at least 12 years of engineering or IT architectural experience, or a Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline with at least 20 years of relevant experience. Degrees in Computer Science, Data Management, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline are preferred.
* You must have a minimum of 6 years of experience analyzing, architecting, and integrating complex enterprise databases, including relational database management systems (RDBMS), NoSQL platforms, storage solutions, and data pipelines.
* You must have demonstrated experience designing and implementing Zero Trust data protection solutions, including automated data classification, data rights management, dynamic access governance, and encryption.
* You must have hands-on experience architecting and securing enterprise data storage and analytics services across both AWS and Microsoft Azure environments.
* You must have experience designing, accrediting, and operating data platforms within classified DoD environments.
* You must possess an active Top Secret security clearance with current SCI eligibility (TS/SCI).
* You must meet DoD 8140/8570 requirements for an IAM Level III or IASAE Level II/III position.
* You must possess an active (ISC)² Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certification.
* You must be a U.S. citizen to be eligible for this position.

Lacking any one of these disqualifies you from this job.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* AWS Certified Data Analytics – Specialty or AWS Certified Database – Specialty certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) certification.
* Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator (SC-400) certification.
* Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) certification.
* Experience implementing DISA Thunderdome Zero Trust capabilities and applying the DoD Data Strategy, DoD Zero Trust Reference Architecture, and NIST SP 800-207.
* Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and DataOps automati
