Our data engineering team is looking for an experienced professional with expertise in SQL, Python, and strong data modeling skills. In this role, you will be at the heart of our data ecosystem, designing and executing cross-engineering initiatives and projects, as well as developing high-quality data pipelines and models that drive decision-making across the organization. You will play a key role in ensuring data quality, building scalable systems, and supporting cross-functional teams with clean, accurate, and actionable data.

**This role requires onsite presence in our New York City office 4 days a week and does not provide immigration support.**

**What you will do:**

* Design, develop, and optimize data services and solutions required to support various company products (like FeatureStore or synthetic data management); Work closely with data analysts, data scientists, engineers, and cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
* Design and integrate LLM- and agent-based capabilities into data platforms and services, enabling smarter data operations and AI-driven data products.
* Design, develop, and optimize scalable data pipelines to ensure data is clean, accurate, and ready for analysis.
* Build and maintain robust data models that support clinical, business intelligence, and operational needs.
* Implement and enforce data quality standards, monitoring, and best practices across systems and pipelines.
* Manage and optimize large-scale data storage and processing systems to ensure reliability and performance.

**What we're looking for:**

* 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer / Backend Engineer (with strong emphasis on data processing)
* Python Proficiency: Proven ability to build services, solutions, data pipelines, automations, and integration tools using Python.
* SQL Expertise: Deep experience in crafting complex queries, optimizing performance, and working with large datasets.
* Strong knowledge of data modeling principles and best practices for relational and dimensional data structures.
* A passion for maintaining data quality and ensuring trust in business-critical data.

**Bonus:**

* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, or Azure) for data engineering and storage solutions.
* Knowledge of data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow)
* Understanding of CI/CD practices and version control systems.
* Experience with Kubernetes.
* Experience in ML/AI development.

**Benefits & Perks:**#LI-Hybrid

* Monday to Thursday onsite work schedule with Fridays remote
* Weekly lunches (Mon, Tues, and Thurs) and stocked kitchen with healthy snacks and beverages
* Monthly social committees for company events
* 18 vacation days, 9 company holidays, 5 sick days, and 2 personal days

* 401k benefit
* Commuter Benefits
* Competitive health, dental, and vision insurance options

Behind every leading health system is K Health's AI-powered virtual care engine.

Our deeply integrated model modernizes the primary care loop by using AI to put humans first. For our patients, we offer clinical AI (i.e., PatientGPT) and unparalleled access to close care gaps around the clock. For our Providers, we deliver provider-serving agentic solutions (i.e., Perfect Note) to eliminate administrative overload and burnout. And for the health systems, we deploy our top-grade Virtualists in AI-powered virtual clinics 24/7 to capture the patients' care journeys at step one, retain the journey through the system for longitudinal care, and strengthen profitability.

We're founded in 2016, headquartered in New York City, and backed by over $443.5M from leading investors including Valor Equity Partners, Claure Group, Mangrove Capital Partners, 14W, Notable Capital, Lerer Hippeau, Primary Venture Partners, Comcast Ventures, PICO Venture Partners, Max Ventures, and other strategic healthcare partners.

We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our users.*

jobs.title: Cloud Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
**ABOUT ANDECO:**

ANDECO Institute is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit based in McLean, Virginia. We serve as a vendor neutral intermediary between U.S. federal agencies and commercial data providers. We evaluate and score commercial data for government customers, and we take no ownership stakes in the vendors we assess. We are a small team, and each person here has a visible effect on what we deliver.

**ABOUT THE ROLE:**

We are adding an engineer to own ANDECO's cloud environment for a federal data platform. A subcontractor will build most of the platform. You will hold the AWS accounts, control who has access, review the subcontractor's infrastructure code and security settings, and show that ANDECO can rebuild the platform from the source it receives. You will also support the APIs and services that serve data to users, and work with our data engineers on how data is stored and indexed.

You will work closely with ANDECO's data engineers and analysts, the application developers who build on the platform, and the subcontractor's engineers. Part of the job is translating between those groups and keeping the platform fast, secure, and easy to use.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**

* Own the platform's AWS accounts, root credentials, and IAM structure, and give the subcontractor only the access its work needs.
* Review the subcontractor's infrastructure code, network design, and security configuration before deployment, and return anything that does not meet ANDECO requirements.
* Rebuild the platform in a clean account from delivered source and infrastructure code at agreed points, and report what fails.
* Track cloud spend against the plan and flag overruns early.
* Design and operate production APIs and services on AWS that serve platform data to users.
* Learn how the data engineering team governs its data, then design endpoints that are easy for end users to call and fast enough for heavy use.
* Support the application development team with API authentication, token lifecycle management, and end to end tracking of how users interact with the data.
* Monitor and enforce cloud security practices for the services you run, including IAM policy, network configuration, WAF rules, and data protection.
* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks in production, and optimize latency, concurrency, and throughput while controlling costs.
* Collaborate with data engineers to improve how data is stored and indexed for API performance. When available, assist with data engineering work as the team needs support.
* Follow ANDECO processes and recommend improvements where they would help.
* Use ANDECO provided AI tools in your daily work.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* At least 4 years building and running production software in cloud environments, including at least 2 years on production APIs and 2 years on data engineering pipelines or frameworks.
* Python and SQL, plus the ability to pick up other languages as needed.
* Hands on AWS experience with Lambda and API Gateway, and with security services such as IAM, VPC configuration, WAF, and Shield.
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation, including reviewing code written by others.
* Experience querying and serving data from Databricks or a comparable distributed platform such as Redshift or Spark, with an understanding of data governance design.
* Experience securing APIs with standards such as OAuth2 and JWT, including token lifecycle management.
* Experience logging system health and user activity so that service quality and usage can be measured.
* Clear written and spoken communication, and experience working between engineering teams.
* Experience using AI tools in professional work, and willingness to adopt ANDECO provided AI tools.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
* U.S. citizenship and the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance. Employment is contingent on a successful pre-employment background check.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience reviewing or taking over cloud environments built by an outside vendor.
* Flask, FastAPI, or a similar Python web framework.
* Experience tuning APIs that stream or query large volumes of analytical data with low latency.
* Familiarity with AWS cost optimization.
* Experience handling sensitive or controlled data, such as PII, CUI, or data covered by NIST 800 series controls.

**BENEFITS:**

ANDECO offers paid time off, medical, dental, and vision coverage, voluntary life insurance, and a 403(b) retirement plan.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY:**

ANDECO Institute is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know.

Pay: $130,000.00 - $155,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in McLean, VA 22102

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
AI Engineer  
Mid-Level | Dallas, TX (Hybrid) | Full-Time

WHO WE ARE

Computer Visionaries (CV.AI) is a Dallas-based AI software development firm that helps businesses achieve AI sovereignty and get off the SaaS treadmill. We don't believe in renting someone else's roadmap. We believe in building solutions purpose-built for each client's business, powered by the latest in agentic AI and intelligent automation.

We work across industries, including manufacturing, construction, investment management, and hospitality, helping organizations use agentic technology to transform how they operate. Our engagements range from replacing bloated SaaS stacks with custom AI-driven workflows to building multi-agent systems that automate entire business processes.

At CV.AI, we see agentic development and vibe coding as personal multipliers. Agents represent a fundamental shift in how software gets built and delivered. Our team members respond, “I'll get my agent on that,” for everything from architecture design to task updates. If that mindset resonates with you, keep reading.

POSITION DETAILS

Job Title: AI Engineer  
Level: Mid-Level  
Employment Type: W2, Full-Time  
Location: Hybrid — Dallas, TX (Galleria / Addison area)  
Reports To: VP, AI Engineering  
Compensation: Competitive, commensurate with experience

ROLE OVERVIEW

We're looking for a mid-level AI Engineer who uses AI agents as a personal force multiplier to architect, test, document, and ship production-grade solutions for our clients.

You'll work on client engagements across industries, translating business requirements into agentic workflows, deploying intelligent systems, and ensuring every deliverable meets enterprise standards for security, scalability, and repeatability.

You'll also regularly interact with clients, explaining technical deliverables clearly and confidently. You'll work alongside senior engineers and engagement leads in small, fast-moving teams where every team member has an outsized impact.

To meet our clients' requirements, this role is open only to U.S. citizens and permanent residents. An offer of employment may be contingent on a background check.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions, from single-agent workflows to multi-agent orchestration, with agents serving as core functionality, user interfaces, or both.
* Use spec-driven and test-driven development practices with AI agents to produce reliable, secure, tested, and well-documented code.
* Identify and bring new applications of AI to our clients' businesses.
* Evaluate agent-produced code for quality, security, and alignment with client requirements.
* Build and integrate client-facing applications that embed AI capabilities where users work, replacing manual processes and legacy SaaS tools.
* Contribute to agentic knowledge systems, including RAG pipelines, agent memory architectures, and shared human-agent wikis.
* Document architectures, decision criteria, integration patterns, and deployment configurations to support knowledge transfer.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* 2–5 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated track record of production deployments.
* Experience using AI agents, coding assistants, or agentic frameworks to deploy production-grade code at a company or for a client.
* Experience with spec-driven and test-driven development workflows.
* Ability to critically evaluate agent-produced code and identify hallucinations, security gaps, and quality issues before deployment.
* A strong focus on security, scalability, repeatability, and well-documented deliverables.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfort presenting technical deliverables and progress directly to clients.
* Familiarity with modern web frameworks, RESTful APIs, and CI/CD workflows.
* Ability to work a hybrid schedule from our Dallas offices in the Galleria / Addison area.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Experience building or implementing agentic knowledge systems, including RAG pipelines, agent memory systems, or wikis designed for shared human-agent use.
* Hands-on experience integrating computer vision technologies into production systems.
* Familiarity with LLM APIs, including Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenAI, or equivalent, and prompt engineering patterns.
* Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or CrewAI, and integration protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Prior experience in consulting, managed services, or client-embedded delivery.
* Experience working in regulated environments or with compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, or HIPAA.
* Proficiency in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or both.

THE MINDSET WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're hiring for technical skills and a way of thinking. The right candidate sees AI agents as teammates. When a problem lands on your desk, your instinct is to consider which agent can help tackle it, whether that means writing tests, researching an API, scaffolding a service, or reviewing a pull request.

You're curious, you ship, and you hold yourself to a high standard of quality even when agents are doing the heavy lifting.

WHY CV.AI

* Build production systems for real clients at the cutting edge of agentic AI.
* Join small, high-impact teams where your contributions are visible and valued from day one.
* Work a hybrid schedule from our offices near the shops and restaurants of the Galleria and Addison. Some of our coolest work happens in the real world.
* Work with a leadership team that uses agents daily and practices what it preaches. Yes, an agent helped write this posting, and a human edited it.
* Gain exposure to a diverse range of industries and technical challenges. No two engagements are the same.
* Earn competitive W2 compensation with a firm that invests in long-term relationships with its engineers.

Computer Visionaries (CV.AI)  
www.cvaius.com (http://www.cvaius.com)  
Dallas, TX

**HealthPlanOne's mission is to help people find the right health insurance at the right price, so they live healthier lives. We are committed to making the shopping process simpler. Our mission has never been more important than it is today.**

The Software Engineer plays a key role in the modernization of HPOne’s online and backend platforms using .NET technologies. The Software Engineer will work with the engineering team to build and enhance a suite of consumer facing website and will contribute software design and architecture using agile practices.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**

* None

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Build out fast, responsive websites that are optimized for frictionless user experience in a marketing and sales domain
* Work closely with the product owner and software engineer manager to develop and enhance websites based on an agreed roadmap and execute using Agile SDLC
* Incorporate inputs from marketing, UX team, SEO and optimization teams to A/B test and continuously evolve consumer facing websites
* Work in Agile Scrum team to participate and deliver sprint objectives
* Monitor the performance of the applications with a focus on uptime and fast response time
* Performs other related duties as assigned

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field
* 5 years of hands-on software development experience
* Expertise in building consumer facing website using Javascript based frameworks such as ReactJS framework and associated libraries like Redux and Next.JS (React JS is preferred however similar technologies like AngularJS, Vue, other Javascript frameworks will be considered)
* Proven ability to build web applications and content rich sites using a CMS
* Proficiency in the following areas: OOP using .NET or Java, CSS, HTML5, Cloud Technologies, CI/CD, MVC, RDBMS

**Preferred Skills/Abilities:**

* Familiar with marketing concepts like A/B Testing, SEO, analytics, conversion rates, campaign monitoring, email marketing, etc.
* Familiarity with Azure Cloud, NewRelic, Optimizely, Headless CMS like Prismic.io
* Experience building websites in a marketing and sales domain

**Physical Requirements:**

* Must be able to remain in a stationary position (e.g., sitting or standing) for extended periods of time, typically in a cubicle environment (constant noise, fluorescent overhead lighting)
* Frequent use of a computer, dual monitors, keyboard, mouse, and other standard office equipment such as a telephone, copier, and printer.
* Must be able to communicate effectively, including exchanging information in person, in writing, by telephone, email or video conferencing.
* Visual and auditory acuity required to perform job duties effectively, including reading, writing, and interpreting information on screens or in print.
* Hand dexterity, fine motor skills needed to operate a keyboard and mouse efficiently
* Reach with hands and arms occasionally

**For Hybrid Roles:**

* Must be able to commute to an office setting as required, which may include walking short distances and navigating an office environment.
* Occasionally moves about the office to access files, office machinery, and meet with others.

jobs.title: Software Engineer III- AI, LLM & Data Platforms
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.

As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within the Consumer & Community Banking, you are an integral part of an agile team that works to enhance, build, and deliver trusted market-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. As a core technical contributor, you are responsible for conducting critical technology solutions across multiple technical areas within various business functions in support of the firm's business objectives.

**Job responsibilities:**

* Deliver end-to-end platform features for agent-based artificial intelligence use cases, from technical design through production deployment, monitoring, and ongoing improvements
* Drives team adoption of enterprise-authorized AI-assisted engineering practices within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and operational outcomes (e.g., AI-assisted code review/refactoring, test strategy acceleration, incident/root-cause analysis support), while establishing consistent validation standards (secure coding, peer review, automated testing) and promoting reuse of effective patterns across the team.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
* Build and maintain reusable services and components that enable teams to create, evaluate, and operate LLM-powered agents at scale
* Implement evaluation and testing approaches for LLM systems, including quality measurement, regression testing, and error analysis to improve reliability over time
* Develop observability capabilities such as tracing, metrics, logs, and analytics to support healthy operations and fast troubleshooting
* Apply security, safety, and governance-by-design patterns, including guardrails, access controls, and audit-ready operational practices aligned to security and governance requirements
* Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to define success metrics, prioritize work, and deliver measurable business impact
* Partner across engineering, data, security, and risk and compliance stakeholders to ensure solutions are secure, stable, and scalable
* Produce clear documentation and reference implementations that accelerate adoption and promote responsible, consistent engineering practices

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills:**

* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3+ years applied experience
* Proficiency in Python with strong software engineering fundamentals, including testing practices, version control, and code review
* Experience building and operating production services, including incident readiness, performance tuning, and operational stability for data-intensive systems
* Hands-on experience delivering machine learning and/or LLM-enabled features into production environments, including monitoring and post-deployment iteration
* Demonstrated experience leading effective use of approved AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., for coding, code review, test acceleration, troubleshooting) with the ability to set team expectations for validating AI outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Strong understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; experience coaching engineers on safe, compliant adoption within delivery practices
* Practical experience with prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), including evaluation methods and quality measurement
* Ability to design maintainable systems and make sound technical decisions through ambiguity, balancing delivery speed, risk, and long-term sustainability
* Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Strong collaboration skills and demonstrated ability to partner effectively across teams to deliver outcomes

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills:**

* Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (for example, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or comparable orchestration approaches) and LLM evaluation tooling
* Experience with continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices and production deployments using Docker and Kubernetes
* Familiarity with vector databases, embedding pipelines, and related approaches used in retrieval-augmented generation solutions
* Experience with cloud and machine learning platforms such as Amazon Web Services or Databricks (or comparable platforms)
* Experience contributing to governance, validation approaches, or guardrail frameworks for enterprise-scale artificial intelligence solutions

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS Emerging Planning Solutions
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Are you passionate about building software that impacts millions of customers? We're looking for a Software Development Engineer II to join our team at Amazon. In this role, you will design, build, and deliver features across the full software development lifecycle—from understanding customer needs through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. You'll work on challenging problems that require clear thinking and simple, effective solutions, while collaborating with engineers and stakeholders to ensure the right outcomes for customers. If you're a self-starter who thrives on solving complex problems and mentoring others, we'd love to hear from you.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Design and implement software solutions that improve quality, performance, and maintainability across major portions of your team's systems, balancing both customer and technical requirements.
* Contribute across the full software development lifecycle including product definition, scoping, design, coding, testing, deployment, and ongoing operations, while identifying and resolving root causes of operational issues.
* Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand business and customer value, ensuring your solutions address real needs and deliver meaningful impact.
* Mentor and coach fellow engineers through code reviews and knowledge sharing, training new team members on system architecture and operational practices.
* Evaluate new tools, approaches, and generative AI capabilities to augment productivity and solution quality, making recommendations for adoption with your team.

  
A day in the life  
You'll start your day reviewing operational metrics and addressing any issues from the previous night. From there, you might dive into a design discussion for an upcoming feature, pair with a teammate on a tricky implementation, or lead a code review session. Afternoons often involve collaborating with product managers to refine requirements or documenting your system's architecture for the broader team. You'll regularly identify opportunities to simplify and improve the software you work on.  
  
About the team  
Our team is focused on building reliable, scalable software that directly improves the experience for Amazon's customers. We value collaboration, thoughtful engineering, and continuous learning. Every team member has a voice in shaping our technical direction, and we invest in each other's growth through mentorship and open dialogue. We're excited about the road ahead and are looking for engineers who want to make a lasting impact while growing alongside a supportive, inclusive team.  
  
About AWS  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Standardized SMGS Flywheel Tagline Statement  
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

The Embedded Software Team at Motorola Solutions, Inc. delivers firmware for embedded devices including in-car video systems and body cameras. The highly skilled engineers in this team utilize their diverse backgrounds and specializations to develop Linux-based applications in support of the customer solution. The team uses modern C++ to develop highly portable code, and utilize state-of-the-art tools and systems throughout the development life cycle.

**Job Description**
-------------------

We are seeking an Embedded Software Engineer to join our team in developing robust, scalable software for Linux-based embedded systems. In this role, you will be responsible for the full software lifecycle from architecture and C++ development to unit testing, system maintenance, and code reusability across production hardware.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* **Application Development:** Architect, code, and maintain embedded software applications using modern C++.
* **System Integration:** Work with vendor-provided APIs/SDKs, define clean software interfaces, and debug complex system-level issues on production hardware.
* **Agile Execution:** Author and refine user stories, execute unit and system-level tests, and participate in sprint deliverables within an Agile environment.
* **CI/CD Build Pipeline:** Utilize multi-stage continuous integration processes to build, test, and release reliable embedded software loads.
  

  

**Qualifications**

* **Core Experience:** 1+ years of experience in C++ development paired with hands-on exposure to Linux-based embedded systems
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with low-level systems including Bare Metal C development, Linux Kernel drivers, device trees, and Yocto implementations.
* Familiarity with real-time operating system (RTOS) considerations, networking protocols, and CI/CD pipeline management.
* Exposure to Linux UI development, Android development, Open Source tools, or embedded neural network applications.

**Basic Requirements**
----------------------

* Bachelor’s degree.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented programming in C++ paired with hands-on experience developing Linux-based embedded systems.
* Legal authorization to work in the U.S. indefinitely is required. Employer work permit sponsorship is not available for this position.

-----------------------

Under 10%

**Relocation Provided**

None

**Position Type**

New Grad

Yes

* Incentive Bonus Plans
* Medical, Dental, Vision benefits
* 401K with Company Match
* 10 Paid Holidays
* Generous Paid Time Off Packages
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Paid Parental & Family Leave
* and more!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

**Company Overview:** Causeway Capital Management LLC provides equity investment management services primarily to institutional clients including corporations, pension plans, sovereign wealth funds, superannuation funds, public retirement plans, Taft-Hartley pension plans, endowments and foundations, mutual funds and other collective investment vehicles, charities, private trusts and funds, model and SMA programs, and other institutions. The firm began operations in June 2001 and manages international, global, emerging market, small cap and sustainable equity strategies. Causeway employs a unique blend of fundamental and quantitative investment strategies and offers its clients access to the firm’s proprietary risk analytics.

**Standard Job Description**
----------------------------

You will be an Algorithm Engineer on the Lockheed Martin Aeronautics Sensor Fusion team, working at the forefront of sensor fusion, perception, and autonomy for fighter and unmanned platforms. In this role you will have a significant impact on shaping the future of Sensor Fusion across Aeronautics, defining the vision for our next‑generation platforms, and integrating Lockheed Martin’s most advanced technologies. If you thrive on pushing the envelope, enjoy tackling difficult algorithmic challenges, and are passionate about turning novel sensor concepts into flight‑ready software, this position on our Emerging‑Technology Sensor Fusion team is for you.

As an engineer working in sensor fusion you will possess a combination of skills from various disciplines:

**Programming Fundamentals**

Programming Languages: Proficiency in languages such as Python, C++, C#, or MATLAB.  
Software Frameworks: Familiarity with software frameworks, such as NumPy, SciPy, or TensorFlow, MATLAB, MATLAB Object Oriented, for numerical computations.  
Simulation Tools: Knowledge of simulation tools, such as Simulink or MATLAB, for modeling and testing sensor fusion systems.

**Mathematical Foundations**

Linear Algebra: Understanding of vector spaces, linear transformations, and matrix operations.  
Probability Theory and Statistics: Familiarity with probability distributions, Bayes' theorem, and stochastic processes. Knowledge of statistical inference, estimation, and hypothesis testing.  
Advanced topics: Understanding of numerical optimization, convex optimization, non-linear optimization, machine learning, and/or mathematical methods.

**Signal Processing and Filtering**

Signal Processing: Understanding of signal processing techniques, such as filtering, convolution, and Fourier analysis.  
Kalman Filter: Familiarity with the Kalman filter algorithm, its variants (e.g., Extended Kalman Filter, Unscented Kalman Filter), and applications.  
Particle Filter: Knowledge of particle filter algorithms and their applications in non-linear, non-Gaussian systems.

**Tracking**

Embedded Development: Acute proficiency in Programming Fundamentals applied to embedded systems.  
Sensor Modeling: Understanding of sensor characteristics, noise models, calibration techniques, Signal Processing and Filtering, and Mathematical Foundations.  
Data Association: Familiarity with data association techniques, such as nearest neighbor, joint probabilistic data association, and multiple hypothesis tracking.  
State Estimation: Knowledge of state estimation algorithms, including Kalman filters, particle filters, and Bayesian estimation methods.

**Sensor Integration and Management**

Resource Allocation: Experience tasking, prioritizing, and scheduling of sensors and maximizing information value, system needs, or target tracking accuracy with a deep understanding of Programming Fundamentals.  
Sensor Integration: Experience with integrating sensors like LIDAR, RADAR, or cameras and offboard sources.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

- Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field

- Experience with C++, C#, Rust, MATLAB, and/or Python

- Real Time Operating System (RTOS) experience – (Windows & Linux)

- Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams

**Desired Skills**

- Project experience in sensor fusion sub-domain(s) (e.g. state estimation, identification, correlation, sensor tasking) or coursework across domains including signal processing, artificial intelligence, autonomy/perception, artificial intelligence, navigation, or control systems in a sensor/systems application.

- Experience implementing Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or statistical algorithms in real time operating systems

- Strong understanding of Object Oriented Programming (OOP)/Object Oriented Design (OOD)

- Strong mathematical foundation in Linear Algebra, Probability Theory, and Statistics

====================

As a national integrated architecture and engineering firm, we are advancing how artificial intelligence connects knowledge, improves workflows, and empowers our people to deliver exceptional outcomes.

You will build and optimize production AI solutions, evaluate large language models, improve AI-generated responses, and transform organizational knowledge into secure, accessible, and actionable intelligence.

Working within our Data & AI team, you will own defined technical initiatives and collaborate with developers, data engineers, and business stakeholders. This role offers opportunities to influence technical decisions and grow into broader platform leadership.

**Essential Functions**

**AI Model Evaluation and Performance**
---------------------------------------

* Develop and maintain model benchmarking, evaluation datasets, testing methods, and performance baselines across production AI applications.
* Evaluate models, prompts, and configurations against response quality, reliability, cost, latency, and risk; document findings and recommend improvements.
* Support preproduction validation of model, prompt, and application changes.

-------------------------------------------

* Develop and optimize retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), retrieval ranking, prompt structures, context management, and caching.

----------------------------------------

* Deliver defined AI use cases from requirements and design through implementation, testing, documentation, adoption, and improvement.
* Help design workflows that capture and organize employee expertise, skills, and competencies for use in AI-powered applications.
* Develop structured data models, skills taxonomies, and knowledge capture workflows; partner with data engineering to integrate governed datasets.
* Work with business stakeholders to define requirements, success criteria, and practical solutions.

**Data Governance and Responsible AI**
--------------------------------------

* Apply privacy, security, data classification, consent, retention, and access-control requirements to AI solutions and datasets.
* Support dataset quality, lineage, ownership, documentation, and auditability.

**Technical Collaboration and Innovation**
------------------------------------------

* Contribute to architecture discussions, technical reviews, coding standards, automated testing, CI/CD, and code reviews.
* Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly and share technical knowledge with colleagues.
* Evaluate emerging generative AI and agentic technologies for practical application at HED.

* Approximately 4–6+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, data engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Hands-on experience developing, deploying, or supporting LLM applications in production.

* Working knowledge of RAG, information retrieval, prompt engineering, and context optimization.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL, Git, automated testing, and modern software development practices.
* Experience with cloud applications, APIs, and data integration workflows.
* Understanding of enterprise data governance, privacy, and security.
* Ability to independently deliver complex technical assignments and communicate effectively with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic, or comparable AI platforms.
* Familiarity with Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, or similar platforms.
* Experience with AI agents, automated workflows, experiment tracking, or multi-model systems.

**Physical Requirements**
=========================

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to effectively communicate in writing and verbally via phone, video conferencing, and in person.
* Visual acuity to perform responsibilities.

**Work Environment**
====================

We embrace a hybrid model that promotes both autonomy and collaboration, including the freedom to work from home, with regular in-office days to connect with teammates and build culture.

The office is a professional, open-space environment designed for collaborative and independent work.

At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. ===================

**About the Role**
------------------

Bose is seeking a **Machine Learning Engineer** with expertise in Efficient AI and Edge ML to join our team. In this role, you will design, train, optimize, and deploy machine learning models for next-generation audio products. You will work closely with embedded, DSP, compiler, hardware, and software engineers to bring AI capabilities to resource-constrained devices.

* Develop and maintain repeatable workflows for model training, conversion, compilation, simulation, validation, and performance analysis.
* Collaborate across Machine Learning, embedded software, DSP, hardware, compiler, and product engineering teams to deliver production-ready AI solutions.

* Document experiments, technical findings, deployment learnings, and reusable engineering practices.

**Minimum Qualifications**
--------------------------

* M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* Strong foundation in machine learning and deep learning, including model architecture design, training, evaluation, and optimization.
* Working knowledge of Efficient ML techniques such as quantization, pruning, knowledge distillation, model compression, and efficient model architectures.
* Understanding of how model optimization techniques affect model accuracy, latency, memory footprint, compute requirements, and deployment compatibility.
* Proficiency with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar.
* Strong Python programming, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Working knowledge of C/C++ and the ability to collaborate effectively with engineers working on embedded and production systems.

* Ability to analyze model behavior and troubleshoot issues across training, conversion, deployment, and integration workflows.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with quantization-aware training, post-training quantization, mixed-precision inference, structured or unstructured pruning, operator replacement, or hardware-aware model optimization.
* Experience adapting model architectures or training workflows in response to deployment and integration constraints.
* Experience deploying machine learning models on edge devices, DSPs, NPUs, mobile platforms, wearable devices, or other resource-constrained systems.
* Familiarity with deployment frameworks and toolchains such as TensorFlow Lite, TensorFlow Lite Micro, ONNX Runtime, TVM, MLIR, or vendor-specific SDKs.

* Curiosity about the interaction between machine learning models, software toolchains, and hardware platforms.

jobs.title: Scientific Software Engineer – Machine Programming
jobs.description:
**Summary**

This role helps the scientists who build and operate QuEra's neutral-atom quantum computers program those machines effectively. You will maintain the domain-specific language and compiler stack, built on the open-source Kirin toolchain, that experimental physicists use every day to run their experiments.

You will work closely with physicists and control stack engineers. You'll help machine teams turn new experiments into working programs, keep the toolchain reliable as our hardware evolves, and drive its integration with our control system. The role suits an engineer who enjoys building tools and also helping others succeed with them.

**Responsibilities**

* Maintain the domain-specific language and its compilation stack: triage issues, fix bugs, review pull requests, manage releases and keep CI, tests and dependencies healthy.
* Act as the point of contact for machine and testbed teams programming their experiments. Help them build new experiments, port legacy programs and diagnose compilation or runtime problems.
* Work with control stack engineers on integrating compiled programs with our control system. This includes defining and evolving the program representation passed between the compiler and the control system, keeping the two in sync across releases, and debugging problems that span both.
* Turn user problems into minimal reproducible reports, regression tests and focused fixes, and work with the compiler team on larger language or IR changes.
* Find and fix performance problems in program compilation and execution, such as compile time, program size and timing correctness.
* Write and maintain user-facing documentation, tutorials, example programs and agent skills that make it easier for physicists to write correct programs.
* Work with the hardware control team to support new channel types, control hardware and machine configurations.
* Collect feedback from machine users and turn it into a prioritized roadmap for usability improvements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Strong Python skills, including type hints, packaging and testing (pytest).
* Enjoys building tools for, and working closely with, scientists who are not professional software developers. Clear written and verbal communication.
* Experience working across team boundaries: agreeing on interfaces, coordinating changes between components and debugging problems that span several systems.
* Experience debugging unfamiliar code and reducing complex failures to minimal reproductions.
* Familiarity with the full software lifecycle: version control, code review, testing, CI/CD, logging, profiling, debugging and documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with compilers, domain-specific languages or SSA-based intermediate representations (experience with Kirin, MLIR or LLVM is a plus).
* Background in experimental physics, especially AMO or atomic physics lab control (AWGs, AOMs/AODs, DDS, timing systems, cameras).
* Experience with real-time or embedded control systems, FPGAs, or experiment-control frameworks such as ARTIQ or Labscript.
* Experience with real-time scheduling or execution systems, such as runtime schedulers, streaming or instruction-dispatch systems.
* Experience with C++ or Rust.
* Contributions to open-source libraries.
* Experience using AI coding agents in a development workflow.

The approximate base salary range for this position is $102,400 - $166,400.

We consistently monitor external market data and update base salary ranges accordingly. We determine base compensation decisions on several factors, including as geographic placement, role-specific knowledge, skills, and/or experience. In addition to our base salary offerings, we also provide equity grants for all new hires.

QuEra is committed to cultivating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We highly value diversity in our current and future employees and do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

As an applied research organization, we focus on capability development and demonstration while remaining decoupled from protracted product lifecycles and system support roles. jobs.title: Research Scientist / Research Engineer, Automated Safety
jobs.description:
**Your Impact at LILA**

We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.

As scientific AI systems become more capable and autonomous, their safety assessment and safeguards must develop alongside them. At Lila Sciences, you will help build the research methods and tools that make this possible, so that more and more decision-enablers can be automated safely. This will move us closer to the vision of a safety and security apparatus that is robust to a fully autonomous scientific engine.

Your initial focus will be misuse: developing flexible and automated red-teaming approaches that test safety-relevant scientific capabilities and the robustness of safeguards. You will also contribute to safety automation beyond red teaming, helping the team evaluate, monitor and respond to risks across increasingly autonomous scientific workflows. You will own reusable research methods and assessment tools, working with mitigation engineers who implement protective mechanisms. We welcome Research Scientists and Research Engineers; responsibilities can span or evolve between the two profiles.

**What You'll Be Building**

* Develop and run capability evaluations of scientific models, agents and tool-mediated workflows (including simulated lab environments), working with domain experts to make tests scientifically meaningful.
* Create methods or systems that explore diverse failure modes, adapt tests as evidence emerges and support systematic investigation beyond fixed benchmarks.
* Build reproducible experiments and evaluation tools that capture relevant behavior, outcomes and the evidence needed to interpret findings.
* Measure the quality and coverage of automated assessments, including failure cases in the evaluators themselves.
* Develop broader safety automation, across threat model management, evidence triage, regression testing, monitoring workflows or tools that help researchers assess and respond to risks.
* Collaborate with risk researchers and mitigation engineers to translate findings into improved assessments and safeguards, and verify whether those changes work.

**What You'll Need to Succeed**

* Strong empirical judgment, practical programming ability and experience working with modern AI systems.
* The ability to investigate ambiguous failures, design informative comparisons and communicate limitations clearly.
* An interest in scientific misuse risks and the ability to collaborate productively with domain specialists.
* **For the Research Scientist profile:** evidence of selecting valuable research questions, developing or adapting methods, and designing experiments that yield defensible conclusions. You should be able to prototype and test your ideas.
* **For the Research Engineer profile:** evidence of building reliable research software, evaluation infrastructure or agent systems that enable reproducible experiments and efficient iteration. You should be able to contribute to experimental design and interpretation.

**Bonus Points For**

* Automated red teaming, adversarial testing or evaluation-method research.
* Scientific AI, tool-using agents, laboratory automation or other complex environments.
* Experience with safety monitoring, model-based evaluators or scalable experimental infrastructure.

**About LILA**

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

**We're All In**

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

**A Note to Agencies**

*Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science's internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.*

new_jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

More and more PlanetScale databases are created, connected and queried by AI agents. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex and a growing list of other tools now sit between developers and their infrastructure.

You will own that experience end to end. You'll make sure PlanetScale shows up everywhere developers build with AI, that our MCP server and CLI work flawlessly in every agent, and that we can measure how well it all works. Then you'll show the world how to do it well through demos, docs, blog posts, videos, and conferences.

This is a hands-on role combining engineering, content creation, and a strong public voice. You'll work closely with the teams that build our MCP server, CLI, API and docs.

The landscape of how developers work with AI changes fast. You'll have the opportunity to move quickly, experiment, and take the lead on the future of AI use with databases and infrastructure.

**Make PlanetScale great with AI tools**
----------------------------------------

* Build and maintain the plugins for PlanetScale in every AI marketplace and directory: agent plugins, skill registries, MCP directories, IDE extension stores and AI app builders
* Own our integrations with AI coding tools, agent frameworks and platforms
* Stay current with AI tools as they launch and ensure our customers have a great experience from day one
* Test the PlanetScale MCP server and CLI across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code and other clients, and catch regressions before users do
* Find friction in creating a database, connecting, running migrations and debugging queries from inside an agent, then fix it or drive the fix with the owning team
* Improve the context agents rely on: tool descriptions, skills, llms.txt, docs written for agents, and error messages agents can act on
* Attention to AEO (answer engine optimization): make sure agents find and recommend PlanetScale
* Build and maintain skills for working with Postgres, MySQL, Vitess, Neki, and PlanetScale

**Measure how well we're doing**
--------------------------------

* Build evals that run real agent tasks against PlanetScale databases
* Benchmark how agents perform with PlanetScale and work towards continuous improvement
* Track how often AI assistants and agents recommend PlanetScale for database questions, and whether what they say about us is accurate
* Instrument and report on agent usage: databases created by agents, time to first connection, MCP versus CLI usage, and where sessions fail

**Show people how to do it well**
---------------------------------

* Build demos and sample apps that show PlanetScale and AI tooling at their best
* Write docs, guides and blog posts on using databases effectively with AI, including safe access, branching and performance assessment
* Make videos and attend conferences to communicate with our audience how to build effectively with AI

**These attributes best describe you**
--------------------------------------

* Daily use of AI coding agents, with strong opinions about what makes a tool work well with them
* Experience building an MCP server, plugin, CLI or SDK that real developers use
* Software engineering background in languages like TypeScript and Go, and comfort with APIs, OAuth and the command line
* Experience with writing docs, blogs, and / or video content creation
* Good at communicating with a broad audience and customers alike on socials
* Experience working with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, SQLite), schema design, migrations, connection handling, and Postgres or MySQL in production
* Data fluency: designing evals, writing the queries behind a dashboard, and telling a real trend from noise
* Clear communication of technical ideas in writing, on video and on stage
* Independence and speed: spotting a gap, shipping a fix, and telling people about it
* Genuine curiosity about the AI tooling landscape and a habit of keeping up with it

**Bonus points**
----------------

* Contributions to the MCP spec, SDKs or popular open-source MCP servers
* Experience writing agent skills, plugins or rules files for Claude Code, Cursor or Codex
* Experience with LLM eval tools and building benchmarks for agents
* Experience with AEO or GEO, or with tracking how LLMs surface and recommend a product
* A blog, YouTube channel or GitHub that developers already follow
* Experience with Vitess, database sharding, or running databases at scale
  

### **Why PlanetScale**

We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Software Engineer, you'll be at the core of building the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

### **Total Compensation and Pay Transparency**

An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.

Base Salary Range: $170,000 - $220,000

AI Engineer  
Mid-Level | Dallas, TX (Hybrid) | Full-Time

WHO WE ARE

Computer Visionaries (CV.AI) is a Dallas-based AI software development firm that helps businesses achieve AI sovereignty and get off the SaaS treadmill. We don't believe in renting someone else's roadmap. We believe in building solutions purpose-built for each client's business, powered by the latest in agentic AI and intelligent automation.

We work across industries, including manufacturing, construction, investment management, and hospitality, helping organizations use agentic technology to transform how they operate. Our engagements range from replacing bloated SaaS stacks with custom AI-driven workflows to building multi-agent systems that automate entire business processes.

At CV.AI, we see agentic development and vibe coding as personal multipliers. Agents represent a fundamental shift in how software gets built and delivered. Our team members respond, “I'll get my agent on that,” for everything from architecture design to task updates. If that mindset resonates with you, keep reading.

POSITION DETAILS

Job Title: AI Engineer  
Level: Mid-Level  
Employment Type: W2, Full-Time  
Location: Hybrid — Dallas, TX (Galleria / Addison area)  
Reports To: VP, AI Engineering  
Compensation: Competitive, commensurate with experience

ROLE OVERVIEW

We're looking for a mid-level AI Engineer who uses AI agents as a personal force multiplier to architect, test, document, and ship production-grade solutions for our clients.

You'll work on client engagements across industries, translating business requirements into agentic workflows, deploying intelligent systems, and ensuring every deliverable meets enterprise standards for security, scalability, and repeatability.

You'll also regularly interact with clients, explaining technical deliverables clearly and confidently. You'll work alongside senior engineers and engagement leads in small, fast-moving teams where every team member has an outsized impact.

To meet our clients' requirements, this role is open only to U.S. citizens and permanent residents. An offer of employment may be contingent on a background check.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Design, build, and deploy agentic AI solutions, from single-agent workflows to multi-agent orchestration, with agents serving as core functionality, user interfaces, or both.
* Use spec-driven and test-driven development practices with AI agents to produce reliable, secure, tested, and well-documented code.
* Identify and bring new applications of AI to our clients' businesses.
* Evaluate agent-produced code for quality, security, and alignment with client requirements.
* Build and integrate client-facing applications that embed AI capabilities where users work, replacing manual processes and legacy SaaS tools.
* Contribute to agentic knowledge systems, including RAG pipelines, agent memory architectures, and shared human-agent wikis.
* Document architectures, decision criteria, integration patterns, and deployment configurations to support knowledge transfer.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* 2–5 years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated track record of production deployments.
* Experience using AI agents, coding assistants, or agentic frameworks to deploy production-grade code at a company or for a client.
* Experience with spec-driven and test-driven development workflows.
* Ability to critically evaluate agent-produced code and identify hallucinations, security gaps, and quality issues before deployment.
* A strong focus on security, scalability, repeatability, and well-documented deliverables.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfort presenting technical deliverables and progress directly to clients.
* Familiarity with modern web frameworks, RESTful APIs, and CI/CD workflows.
* Ability to work a hybrid schedule from our Dallas offices in the Galleria / Addison area.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Experience building or implementing agentic knowledge systems, including RAG pipelines, agent memory systems, or wikis designed for shared human-agent use.
* Hands-on experience integrating computer vision technologies into production systems.
* Familiarity with LLM APIs, including Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, OpenAI, or equivalent, and prompt engineering patterns.
* Experience with agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or CrewAI, and integration protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Prior experience in consulting, managed services, or client-embedded delivery.
* Experience working in regulated environments or with compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP, SOC 2, or HIPAA.
* Proficiency in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or both.

THE MINDSET WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're hiring for technical skills and a way of thinking. The right candidate sees AI agents as teammates. When a problem lands on your desk, your instinct is to consider which agent can help tackle it, whether that means writing tests, researching an API, scaffolding a service, or reviewing a pull request.

You're curious, you ship, and you hold yourself to a high standard of quality even when agents are doing the heavy lifting.

WHY CV.AI

* Build production systems for real clients at the cutting edge of agentic AI.
* Join small, high-impact teams where your contributions are visible and valued from day one.
* Work a hybrid schedule from our offices near the shops and restaurants of the Galleria and Addison. Some of our coolest work happens in the real world.
* Work with a leadership team that uses agents daily and practices what it preaches. Yes, an agent helped write this posting, and a human edited it.
* Gain exposure to a diverse range of industries and technical challenges. No two engagements are the same.
* Earn competitive W2 compensation with a firm that invests in long-term relationships with its engineers.

As a Project Software Engineer III on the Government & Public Services team, you will be responsible for backend development to design, build, test, and sustain the services supporting a secure AI-enabled platform that accelerates medical waiver review.
  

* Design and develop scalable backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and integrations for document ingestion and AI processing.

Required**:**

* Stand up proofs of value, validate results quickly, and convert wins into scalable, supportable solutions.
* Configure, maintain, and support DataOps and MLOps tooling, including pipelines, job orchestration, feature stores, monitoring, and CI/CD.

* Write application specifications and documentation.
* Continuously identify technical risks and gaps; devise mitigation strategies in anticipation of team’s needs.

**Minimum Qualifications:**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or related discipline. Equivalent combination of experience and education will also be considered.
* 3+ years delivering AI or ML applications on enterprise platforms, or a relevant degree with strong internships or projects.
* 1+ year experience with Python, SQL, notebooks, version control, and CI/CD basics.
* Working experience operating production pipelines and jobs, including alerting and observability.

-----------------------------

* Prior experience with enterprise AI application platforms and their semantic/object models (e.g., C3.ai model types, Palantir Foundry ontology).
* Strong software development background with Python and JavaScript, including experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Redux, Vue, Backbone, or Angular).
* Proficient with Git or other version control systems.
* Experience deploying software to leading cloud platforms (e.g., Azure).
* Solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases, data structures, algorithms, and time-series data analysis (including cleansing and normalization).

* Strong grasp of common machine learning techniques, applications, and trade-offs.
* Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik).
* Familiarity with Figma or similar design/prototyping tools for UI/UX collaboration.
* Exposure to plant historians, MES, event streams, or edge integrations.
* Experience managing continuous improvement projects and implementing supply chain AI applications.
* Demonstrated ability to translate business needs into system requirements and communicate effectively across technical and business teams.

--------------------------

* M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field.
